evidence_class: Development evidence only. A check that passes on this profile does not qualify hardware, does not close a blocked gate, and is not release evidence. Hardware qualification needs more than one machine and the acceptance recorded in the milestone.

cpu.architecture_note: architecture is recorded in the mkosi Architecture= spelling x86-64, which is what the product input manifest and the kernel requirement carry; uname -m prints the same machine as x86_64

tpm2.note: discrete TPM 2.0; swtpm also installed for virtual machines; /dev/tpm0 and /dev/tpmrm0 are group tss and the developer account is not a member, so tpm2-tools reads run privileged (a root read of PCR 7 succeeded)

iommu.note: AMD-Vi (ivhd0); VFIO is available as a module

rapl_energy_counters.note: package counters exist; /sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl:0/energy_uj is mode 0400 and root-readable only, so P13 telemetry needs a privileged daemon or a root test

sched_ext.note: the host kernel runs a sched_ext scheduler at probe time; scx_cake, the scheduler P07 proposes, is installed as a distribution package alongside scx_rusty, scx_bpfland and scx_lavd

bpf_lsm.note: bpf appears in the active LSM list

btf.note: CO-RE eBPF programs can be compiled against the host kernel

pci_p2pdma.note: kernel support is compiled in; device-level support still needs proving per device

realtime_kernel.note: the running kernel is PREEMPT_DYNAMIC, but the distribution ships linux-rt 7.2.5.rt3.arch1-1; this is an operator action, not a missing capability

secure_boot_enrolment.note: disabled in the running firmware, and the host carries vendor keys with SetupMode off, so host enrolment needs a firmware-setup visit. That does not gate guest work: a variable store with platform key, KEK and db enrolled and SecureBootEnable set was generated here from the shipped OVMF_VARS with virt-fw-vars, and OVMF_CODE.secboot is installed

resizable_bar.evidence_command: nvidia-smi -q | grep -A2 'BAR1 Memory Usage'; lspci -s 06:00.0 -vv | grep Region
resizable_bar.note: already enabled in firmware: 32 GiB BAR1 on the discrete NVIDIA card and an 8 GiB prefetchable region on the Intel card, which is the firmware prerequisite for peer DMA

gpu_dma_buf_and_peer_memory.note: NVIDIA 615.71.09 open kernel modules (Dual MIT/GPL) with nvidia_drm modeset and the nvidia_peermem peer-memory module installed, CUDA 13.3.1 present; the Intel and AMD cards provide DMA-BUF through their in-tree drivers; the Arc A380 is bound to i915 at probe time, and the same kernel ships xe with a PCI alias for 8086:56a5 (CONFIG_DRM_XE=m), so rebinding it to xe for drm_sched is supported here

swtpm.version: TPM emulator version 0.10.2, Copyright (c) 2014-2022 IBM Corp. and others

scx_schedulers.version: distribution scx package (scx_cake, scx_rusty, scx_bpfland, scx_lavd)

nvidia_fs.note: GPUDirect Storage is gated to datacentre cards, so installing it would not make the path demonstrable here

rustup.note: deliberately not installed: it conflicts with the distribution rust package; the pinned-toolchain choice is decision D61

sbctl.note: virt-firmware covers the OVMF variable store; sbctl is an alternative
